verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is clearly API-first. Its core capabilities are all documented as programmatic: sessions via CDP/WebSocket, stealth, CAPTCHA, proxies, profiles and recordings set at session creation, the Scrape/Crawl/Extract APIs, single-call agent tasks, and sandboxes. It also offers SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server. However, no evidence states that the API matches the UI feature for feature, and no account or dashboard functions (API keys, usage/credits, billing, team management) are shown to be reachable through the API. missing for 10: explicit API–UI parity documentation, API coverage of account/billing/usage/key management, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found all candidate paths 404), independent corroboration of parity.
